description: Terraform provider for managing Synology DSM packages, Container Manager projects, users, groups, shared folders, permissions, quotas, and user home service.
rules: This repository is a Terraform provider for Synology DSM, not Synology DSM itself.
Install it from batonogov/synology-dsm, use dsm as the preferred local provider name, and use dsm_* resource and data source types.
The provider uses terraform-plugin-framework and Terraform protocol 6.0.
Package uninstall, Container Manager project deletion, and user home service disable are opt-in destructive operations; preserve the safe defaults unless destruction is explicitly intended.
A Container Manager project share_path is a File Station path such as /containers/s3-storage, not an absolute /volumeN path.
compose_yaml is marked sensitive but remains stored in Terraform state; use encrypted state and keep long-lived secrets out of Compose YAML.
